name: prose-math
note: Was a documented `prose` fallback gap (KaTeX is JS-only). Math is now Rust-native: `$…$` / `$$…$$` render to MathML via xyd_math (pulldown-latex), so this compiles `full`. Re-tagged `prose` → `math`; the math branch checks full + rendered `<math>` + well-formed MathML (no <merror>). `rendered.html` / `compiled.normalized.js` are retained as the KaTeX reference (KaTeX's HTML+MathML) but are NOT byte-gated — MathML Core is a different DOM from KaTeX by design. Deep functional equivalence to KaTeX is proven across a 77-expression corpus in crates/xyd_math/tests/equivalence.rs.

katexReference.note: KaTeX HTML+MathML output (reference only, not a byte gate).
